items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Willis Jackson was in Smalls. So I got to see all of those guys.

ctx.x: Well, I met everybody who was playing in there. A guy named...I can’t think of his name...a bass player... It was a long time. But then I went on down the street, and I met other
people, like Percy France, and I met another guy down there... Lockjaw was in Minton’s. Big Nick was over at the Paradise, and Willis Jackson was in Smalls. So I got to see all of those guys.
